Repo-state reconciliation, 2026-05-16. Golden Lattice committed repo on main is FULLY OPERATIONAL, not substrate-only. HQ git inspection: main clean, in sync with origin, 274 tests collected across substrate/exchange/orchestrator/synthesis. All layers committed May 2-4: memory_graph (schema/tagging/metrics/store), exchange (phase_1/2/3), synthesis (claim_trace/elevation/disagreement/attribution/engine.synthesize composer), orchestrator (run_lattice_session_async/run_lattice_session, anthropic_client, config, errors), scripts (run_first_live_session.py, run_code_session.py). Last 5 commits all May 4, prompt-tuning against live evidence; HEAD 5fd6ccf (Phase 3 converge two-form anchoring + regression test). Four live sessions persisted in sessions/, all reached Phase 4.

The STALE artifacts are the docs: README.md ('operational layer ships next', lists only memory_graph/), pyproject.toml (version 0.0.1, deps=pydantic only — no anthropic SDK), CONTRIBUTING.md+README ('69 tests'). These froze at the substrate-complete milestone and never got a sync commit when the operational layer landed. Action item, low urgency, not blocking: doc/pyproject sync commit so README/pyproject/CONTRIBUTING reflect operational reality (orchestrator/exchange/synthesis present, ~274 tests, anthropic SDK + async deps).

Methodology note: Anthony uploaded the stale docs as 'ground truth of what this is, read first' after a web-chat seat asked for the orchestrator signature. The docs contradicted the chronicle (chronicle: 273 tests, orchestrator landed; docs: 69 tests, orchestrator ships next). Web-chat seat flagged the divergence and refused to build the streaming wrapper against a possibly-phantom orchestrator until HQ grounded the canonical state source (filesystem, not chronicle, not docs). HQ git inspection resolved it. The flag-before-build discipline prevented writing a wrapper against a reconstructed API. This is declare-before-verify caught on the constructive side: the verification gate fired before the build, not after a wrong build. Canonical state source for repo questions = HQ filesystem; chronicle and docs are both lagging records subject to drift in opposite directions.
